source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education, ONIE Project

ingredients.name: thyme, leaves removed from sprigs and crushed
tilapia fillets, 6 ounces each, or other white fish

steps.instruction: Place 1/3 cup of parmesan cheese and 1 teaspoon of flour in a paper bag.
Add 1 teaspoon of crushed thyme leaves to the bag.
Coat each of the 4 tilapia fillets by shaking it gently in the bag.
Discard the coating ingredients that are left in the bag.
Place the fillets in a baking pan on a rack.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 cup of halved mushroom caps.
Add 1/2 cup of sliced green onions and 1 crushed garlic clove.
Cook, stirring often, until the onions are tender.
Serve the baked fish topped with the mushroom mixture.
